notes:
FORMS:
{爆笑|ばくしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to burst out laughing

ORIGINAL MEANING:
Traditionally, {爆笑|ばくしょう} referred specifically to a group of people laughing loudly together. However, modern usage often applies it to individuals as well.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆笑|ばくしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誘|さそ}う→誘う：01947_sasou⟧ - to invite roars of laughter
- {爆笑|ばくしょう}⟦ネタ→ネタ：06309_neta⟧ - hilarious material/joke
- {爆笑|ばくしょう}{問題|もんだい} - comedy duo name (Bakusho Mondai)

INTERNET SLANG:
wwwww (representing {笑|わら}) and ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧ are internet equivalents for expressing laughter.
